headline: Tribunal reveals RAPID Action Battalion helicopters carried weapons in July
summary: Investigation finds helicopters were loaded with firearms and ammunition during the July mass uprising.
details: A tribunal investigation has revealed the specific types of weapons and ammunition that were loaded onto Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) helicopters during the July mass uprising.
The findings detail the arsenal carried by the aircraft, providing insight into the military capabilities deployed against protesters during the unrest.
The investigation is part of a broader effort to document the force used during the crackdown on the student-led protests.
The tribunal's findings are now part of the official record regarding the operations conducted by the RAB during the crisis.
caption:
What weapons were on RAB helicopters during the July uprising? A tribunal investigation has the answer.

A tribunal investigation has revealed the specific types of weapons and ammunition that were loaded onto Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) helicopters during the July mass uprising.

The findings detail the arsenal carried by the aircraft, providing insight into the military capabilities deployed against protesters during the unrest.

The investigation is part of a broader effort to document the force used during the crackdown on the student-led protests.

The tribunal's findings are now part of the official record regarding the operations conducted by the RAB during the crisis.

#Bangladesh #JulyUprising #RAB #HumanRights #Justice

Source: Prothom Alo

headline_marked: Students and citizens [[declare one-point demand for government fall]] at Shaheed Minar
headline: Students and citizens declare one-point demand for government fall at Shaheed Minar
summary: Massive crowds gathered at the center of the language movement monument to demand the resignation of the current administration.
details: A massive gathering of students and general citizens took place at the Shaheed Minar in Dhaka on July 34th (as per the local calendar/protest timeline).
The participants gathered to formally announce a one-point demand: the immediate fall of the current government.
The event saw a huge influx of people from various walks of life, turning the area around the monument into a sea of protesters.
This escalation marks a significant shift in the movement, moving from specific reforms to a total demand for regime change.
caption:
A sea of people at Shaheed Minar. The demand is now clear: the government must fall.

A massive gathering of students and general citizens took place at the Shaheed Minar in Dhaka on July 34th (as per the local calendar/protest timeline).

The participants gathered to formally announce a one-point demand: the immediate fall of the current government.

The event saw a huge influx of people from various walks of life, turning the area around the monument into a sea of protesters.

This escalation marks a significant shift in the movement, moving from specific reforms to a total demand for regime change.

#Bangladesh #Dhaka #StudentProtest #OnePointDemand #BreakingNews

Source: Somoy News
